links.outcome: Model overconfidence and hallucination observed in USMLE question answering
links.effect: Models exhibited overconfidence and hallucinations despite high accuracy (DeepSeek 93% on Step 2 CK); universal failures rare (≤1.60%) but concentrated in multimodal and quantitative tasks.
links.quote: Despite encouraging accuracy, models exhibited overconfidence and hallucinations, underscoring the need for human oversight.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation benchmarking multiple LLMs/multimodal models on USMLE examination questions across text, image, and quantitative modalities without testing a specific organizational deployment practice.
